You are a senior cybersecurity architect, GRC consultant, CISSP-certified enterprise security strategist, and Saudi compliance expert.

I need you to act as a complete cybersecurity transformation and compliance solution architect for a Saudi Arabian enterprise customer.

The customer is:

* Starting with 200 users
* Expected to scale to 4000 users within 5 years
* Multiple branches across Saudi Arabia
* Will have:

  * Enterprise IT network
  * Highly secured network
  * Air-gapped / isolated environment
* Security is the MAIN CORE of the project
* Customer wants ALL cybersecurity controls mapped technically with budgetary costing

Your task is to create:

1. One professional Technical Proposal document (Word format)
2. One advanced Excel workbook for compliance, technology mapping, vendor selection, and budgetary sizing

The deliverables must look enterprise-grade and suitable for:

* Saudi government
* Oil & gas
* Critical infrastructure
* NCA / SAMA style environments

The solution must align with:

* NCA ECC
* NCA CSCC
* ISO 27001
* NDMO

The architecture and recommendations must follow:

* CISSP best practices
* Zero Trust Architecture
* Defense in Depth
* Least Privilege
* Segmentation and Trust Boundaries
* Secure-by-Design principles

==================================================
PART 1 — TECHNICAL PROPOSAL DOCUMENT
====================================

Create a complete Technical Proposal document in professional Microsoft Word format.

The TP must include:

---

1. Executive Summary

---

* Security-first architecture
* Scalability from 200 to 4000 users
* Compliance-focused design
* Air-gapped network consideration
* Zero Trust readiness

---

2. Scope of Work

---

2.1 In Scope

* Network Security
* L3 Segmentation
* Zero Trust foundation
* Identity & Access Management
* NAC / 802.1X
* NGFW
* East-West inspection
* Secure Internet breakout
* Wireless security
* Secure WAN/MPLS
* Logging and monitoring
* Secure remote access
* OT/IT segregation
* Air-gapped environment security

2.2 Optional / Future Scope

* SOC/SIEM
* XDR/NDR
* SOAR
* Threat Hunting
* DFIR
* Advanced Micro-segmentation

---

3. High-Level Architecture

---

Explain:

* Enterprise network
* Highly secured network
* Air-gapped network
* MPLS + Internet
* Traffic flow
* Segmentation model
* East-West and North-South inspection
* Firewall placement
* NAC placement
* DMZ architecture

---

4. Detailed Technical Design

---

4.1 Campus Architecture

* Core
* Distribution
* Access

4.2 Security Architecture

* NGFW
* IPS

4.3 Identity Security

* RBAC
* MFA

* AAA

4.4 Segmentation

* VLANs
* VRFs
* L3 segmentation
* Trust boundaries
* Secure zones

4.5 Air-Gapped Security

* Secure file transfer
* OPSWAT
* Media scanning
* Offline update architecture
* Controlled access model

---

5. Security Architecture (VERY IMPORTANT)

---

This must be the strongest section.

Align everything with CISSP domains:

* Domain 1 — Security & Risk Management
* Domain 2 — Asset Security
* Domain 3 — Security Architecture & Engineering
* Domain 4 — Communication & Network Security
* Domain 5 — Identity & Access Management
* Domain 6 — Security Assessment & Testing
* Domain 7 — Security Operations
* Domain 8 — Software Development Security

Explain:

* Defense in Depth
* Zero Trust
* Least Privilege
* Segmentation

* Risk Reduction
* Secure Architecture Principles

Map architecture and technologies against:

PART 2 — EXCEL WORKBOOK (VERY IMPORTANT)
========================================

Create a professional Excel workbook with MULTIPLE SHEETS.

The workbook must be enterprise-grade and visually clean.

==================================================
SHEET 1 — MASTER COMPLIANCE MATRIX
==================================

Include ALL controls from:

* NCA ECC
* NCA CSCC
* ISO 27001
* NDMO

Columns must include:

* Framework
* Domain
* Subdomain
* Control ID
* Control Name
* Detailed Description
* Risk Level
* Priority
* Technology Category
* Recommended Technology
* Vendor
* Compliance Status
* Implementation Phase
* Comments

Use color coding:

* Critical
* High
* Medium
* Low

==================================================
SHEET 2 — TECHNOLOGY MAPPING MATRIX
===================================

This is the MOST IMPORTANT SHEET.

Map every cybersecurity control to technologies.

Columns:

* Framework
* Control ID
* Control Description
* Technology Category
* Technology
* Strategic Vendor
* Non-Strategic Vendor
* Product Name
* Part Number
* Qty
* Unit Price
* Total Price
* Sizing Notes
* HA Required
* Air-Gapped Compatible
* Zero Trust Compatible
* Comments

VERY IMPORTANT:
Create DROPDOWN LISTS for:

* Vendor
* Product
* Priority
* Compliance Status

Strategic vendors dropdown MUST include:

* Palo Alto
* Fortinet
* Cisco

Also include other vendors from Gartner and the uploaded non-strategic vendor file.

==================================================
PART NUMBER LOGIC
=================

When vendor is selected:

* Automatically populate:

  * Product Name
  * Part Number
  * Suggested Qty
  * Unit Price (if available)

Use uploaded Fortinet pricing file to extract:

* Product names
* Part numbers
* Pricing

For other vendors:

* If pricing unavailable:

  * Put “NA”
  * Or “0”
